conference: ACS Regional Meetings (MARM, NERM, SERMACS, MWRM, SWRM, NORM, WRM, CERM)
method: Rung 3 (the search at rung 1/2 only LOCATED the artefact; the number comes from counting it). Artefact: the final programme PDF of the Joint Meeting of SERMACS/SWRM 2025 (76th Southeastern + 81st Southwest Regional Meeting, Orlando FL, 26-29 Oct 2025), downloaded from https://www.sermacs2025.org/docs/final-program.pdf?v=20251021 (2,234,263 bytes). The programme prints a per-session table with an explicit 'Paper Number' column; non-paper items (Opening Remarks, Break, Lunch) carry no paper number, which is what makes this countable. Count: pdftotext -layout, then python re.findall on r'^\s{1,6}(\d{1,3})\s{2,}(\d{1,5})\s{2,}\S' (col 1 = order within session, col 2 = paper number), taking unique values of group 2 -> 1,450 unique paper numbers, running 1 to 1467 with exactly 17 gaps (107, 146, 204, 230, 307, 308, 322, 378, 439, 458, 628, 1080, 1123, 1167, 1204, 1218, 1234), i.e. 17 withdrawals against 1,467 IDs issued. Cross-check per method rule: extracted twice, pdftotext -layout and -raw, both report 148 'SESSION TITLE:' blocks, so extraction is not lossy. Session-type tally from the same text: 91 Oral, 33 Poster, 7 Workshop. EXCLUSIONS: split the numbered papers by session title and the only plenary/award/heritage sessions ('Plenary: Reflections on an Analytical Chemistry Career...' and 'SERMACS/SWRM Awards Banquet') carry ZERO numbered papers, so no invited item is inside the 1,450; the file contains 0 occurrences of 'invited' and 1 of 'keynote'. CAVEAT, stated rather than hidden: symposium-invited talks inside ordinary oral sessions are not flagged in this programme, so 1,450 is a small over-count of purely contributed items, and this is a JOINT meeting of two of the eight regionals, so no single regional stands alone at this size. Language: English (US society). 1,450 is under the 1,500 VERIFIED bar and well over the ~900 floor.

conference: Pacifichem
method: Rung 6 (session arithmetic off a published grid), reached after rungs 3-5 were worked and found EMPTY for a reason worth recording: Pacifichem publishes no abstract book, and its abstract system/itinerary planner (ScholarOne, https://pacifichem.abstractcentral.com/planner) is TORN DOWN after the congress - fetched 2026-09-12, it returns HTTP 200 with the body 'Invalid Site - the site you're trying to visit does not exist', so there is no listing left to count and this is not a rung-5 browser job. ARTEFACT COUNTED INSTEAD: the official preliminary session grid PDF, https://pacifichem.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Prelim-Grids-v5.pdf (447,735 bytes, Honolulu, 15-20 Dec 2025), which tabulates every symposium against its oral half-days and its poster day. Extraction: pdftotext -layout, then (a) unique symposium codes via re.findall(r'\[([A-Z]{3}\d{3})\]') -> 298 symposia across 11 topic areas (CES 44, ANA 34, CLH 31, ING 29, MAT 29, BIO 27, ORG 27, MAC 25, PHY 24, CTH 17, ECT 11); (b) oral half-day blocks by counting the grid's own cell labels, 381 'AM & PM' (x2) + 141 'AM Only' + 58 'PM Only' = 961 half-day oral blocks; (c) 267 symposium poster sessions scheduled ('<Weekday>, Dec NN'), with 42 symposia marked 'none'. FIGURE: 961 half-day oral blocks x 6 contributed talks per half-day block = 5,766, recorded as a deliberately CONSERVATIVE FLOOR - a 3-3.5 hour half-day block at 20-minute slots holds 10-12 items, so the realistic central figure is ~7,700-11,500 orals, and the 267 poster sessions are ADDITIONAL and entirely excluded from the 5,766. INVITED: plenary and symposium-invited talks sit inside these same blocks and are NOT separable from this grid, which is a further reason the 6-per-block multiplier is set low rather than at the realistic slot count. Language: English (multi-society Pacific Basin congress, ACS-administered). The floor is ~3.8x the 1,500 bar, so no plausible multiplier changes the verdict. Confidence 'floor' - this is arithmetic on a published grid, not an item count.

conference: IUPAC World Chemistry Congress
method: Rung 3. The search only located the congress; the artefact was then found at zero further search cost by curl-ing https://iupac2025.org/ and grepping its hrefs for .pdf, which returns exactly one: the official Programme Book of the 50th IUPAC World Chemistry Congress (Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, 14-19 July 2025), 36,768,452 bytes, downloaded to iupac.pdf. THIS BOOK LABELS EVERY ITEM BY TYPE, which makes the invited exclusion exact rather than estimated. ORALS: each talk in the detailed programme is printed as '<abstractID> (X): <title>' where X is the type letter. Count of unique (abstractID, type) pairs via re.findall(r'\b(\d{1,4})\s*\(([A-Z])\)\s*:') -> O = 516, I = 183, K = 90, and no other type letter occurs anywhere in the book. ONLY the 516 (O) are counted; the 183 (I) INVITED and 90 (K) KEYNOTE are EXCLUDED per the invited rule, as are the plenaries and the named award lectures (2025 Chemistry Europe Award Lecture, IUPAC-Soong Prize Lecture, PLENARY 3-6 etc.), which are printed with a speaker and no abstract ID at all and so are structurally outside the count. POSTERS: listed under 'Poster Presentation Session 1/2' as a two-column table 'Poster ID | Abstract ID — Title & Author', e.g. 'S1-PP01  1251 — A preliminary study...'. TRAP CAUGHT HERE: the poster ID S<cluster>-PP<nn> is NOT globally unique - it restarts per cluster per session, so a naive unique-count of S\d+-PP\d+ gives 392 (session 1 = 197, session 2 = 198, sum 395) and loses 3 to collisions between the two sessions. The ADJACENT 4-digit ABSTRACT ID is the unique key: re.findall(r'\b(S\d{1,2}-PP\d{1,3})\s+(\d{3,4})\b') returns 395 pairs with 395 distinct abstract IDs -> 395 posters. TOTAL CONTRIBUTED = 516 orals + 395 posters = 911. Cross-check per method rule: extracted twice, pdftotext -layout and -raw, and BOTH return identically O=516, I=183, K=90 and 395 poster pairs, so extraction is not lossy. ATTENDANCE: DELIBERATELY LEFT NULL. A 'more than 3,000 delegates' figure appears in search-result snippets attributed to iupac.org and council.science, but iupac.org/event/iupac-world-chemistry-congress-2025/ does not contain it on the page as fetched and council.science/events/iupac-2025/ returns HTTP 403; a python regex sweep of the programme book for 'delegates|participants|3,?000' finds only prose ('Distinguished delegates', a venue blurb) and NO headcount. Per rule 3 and 'never write down a figure you only saw in a snippet', it is not recorded. DECISIVE-ROW WARNING: 911 is 11 above the ~900 retention floor, so this row was re-derived twice and the poster collision above is exactly the kind of error that would have put it under (392 would have given 908, still over, but the principle holds). Biennial congress. Language: English (IUPAC is anglophone; host society IKM publishes in English).

conference: CSJ Chemistry Festa
method: Rung 4, searched in JAPANESE ('化学フェスタ 2025 発表件数 ポスター発表 参加者数') — English queries return nothing usable for this meeting, exactly as the field notes warn for CSJ. The search located festa.csj.jp; everything below cost ZERO further searches. ARTEFACT: the full programme page of 第15回CSJ化学フェスタ2025 (15th CSJ Chemistry Festa, Tower Hall Funabori, Tokyo, 22-24 Oct 2025), https://festa.csj.jp/2025/program/ — 596,855 bytes of plain HTML, no JS, fetched with curl. The 予稿集 (abstract book) itself is login-walled, but the programme page lists every item with its ID, which is why this is countable without the login. COUNT: stripped tags, then re.findall(r'\bP(\d)-(\d{3})\b') on unique (session, number) pairs -> NINE student poster sessions P1-P9 of 115/114/115/114/114/114/115/115/115 = 1,031 UNIQUE POSTER IDS. Each is a 学生ポスター発表 (student poster) with the presenting author marked ○, e.g. 'P1-001 固液界面の動的平衡状態が誘起する有機無機ペロブスカイトの自己修復反応 ○竹内 愛斗…（神戸大院理）'. EXCLUSIONS, and they matter a lot on this row: (1) the A/B/D/E/F/G-coded items (~169) are テーマ企画 themed-session lectures given by named professors in 30-40 minute slots — INVITED, excluded; verified by opening A1-02, a 40-minute talk by a University of Tokyo associate professor with no submitting-author mark. (2) The C2 series (30 items) is the 博士課程学生オーラルセッション (doctoral student oral session) and is excluded as a DOUBLE COUNT, not as invited: the session's own description states it exists to give 『化学フェスタでポスター発表する博士課程学生』 — students who are ALREADY presenting a poster here — a second, oral platform, so every C2 item is a re-presentation of an abstract already inside the 1,031. Counting them would inflate the row by 30. (3) 開会挨拶/閉会挨拶 (opening/closing remarks) carry no ID. ATTENDANCE: 2,700, basis UNSPECIFIED, rung A3 — stated on the organiser's own 2025 page (https://festa.csj.jp/2025/, opened and read, not a snippet): 「昨年は約2,700名の方々にご参加いただきました」, i.e. ~2,700 attended the 2024 edition; the 2024 page says ~2,600 for 2023, so the series is growing. Implied ratio 1,031/2,700 = 38%, below the CCS National Congress anchor (79%) and the Mendeleev anchor (45%), which is exactly what you would expect of a meeting whose oral programme is invited and whose open call is limited to students. CHARACTER = HYBRID on that evidence: a genuine open contributed call (student posters, which closed early on 2025/07/03 「予定件数に達したため」 — it filled its quota) bolted onto an invited industry-academia-government lecture programme. NOT A DUPLICATE of the CSJ Annual (Spring) Meeting already censused at 3,604 presentations: the Festa is CSJ's separate 秋季事業 (autumn event) with its own call. 1,031 clears the ~900 floor and is under the 1,500 bar.

conference: CSI — Chemical Research Society of India / ICS Annual Convention [QUEUE ROW CONFLATES TWO DIFFERENT SOCIETIES — this row resolved as CRSI National Symposium in Chemistry (CRSI-NSC)]
method: NAMING PROBLEM FIRST: the queue row bundles 'Chemical Research Society of India' with 'Indian Chemical Society' as if they were one body. THEY ARE TWO DIFFERENT SOCIETIES with two different meetings — CRSI (crsi-india.org) runs the CRSI National Symposium in Chemistry (CRSI-NSC), twice a year; the Indian Chemical Society (Kolkata) runs the Annual Convention of Chemists (ACC), whose 61st edition was held at JECRC University Jaipur, 19-21 Dec 2024. This row is resolved as CRSI-NSC; the ICS Annual Convention is queue row 162 and is handled there. Flagged so the two are not merged and the ICS half of this row's title is not lost. Rung 3, English (India's societies publish in English, so no local-language pass applies). ROUTE: two searches located the symposium series; the current editions' own sites are Cloudflare-walled (events.iitgn.ac.in/2025/crsi/ and 34crsi.iiserb.ac.in both fail — 403 interstitial and NXDOMAIN respectively), but the 32nd edition's site at BITS Pilani is plain HTML and publishes the artefacts openly. COUNTED: 'LIST OF POSTER ABSTRACT ACCEPTED' for CRSI-NSC-32 (BITS Pilani, 2-4 Feb 2024), https://www.bits-pilani.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/LIST-OF-POSTER-ABSTRACT-ACCEPTED_29-01-2024.pdf, 653,886 bytes — a list of ACCEPTED abstracts, which is exactly the quantity this census wants. Count: re.findall(r'\bP-(\d{1,3})\b') on unique values -> 297 IDs, running 1 to 297 with ZERO gaps. SANITY-CHECK against the artefact's own stated total, per method rule 7: the document's header declares 'Poster Session 1, P1-148' and 'Poster Session 2, P149-297', i.e. 297, which the independent ID count reproduces exactly. Cross-check: extracted twice, pdftotext -layout and -raw, both 297 with no gaps. ORALS = ZERO CONTRIBUTED. The companion scientific programme, https://www.bits-pilani.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/Scientific-Program-32nd-CRSI-NSc17th-CRSi-RSC-Updated_31-1-2024.pdf (875,582 bytes), is an entirely INVITED lecture programme — 32 named talks each printed as '<Name>, <Institution>' + 'Title: ...' (RSC President Gill Reid, Prof. David O'Hagan, industry R&D directors, CRSI medal lectures), with zero occurrences of 'contributed' or 'oral presentation' and no submitted-oral session anywhere. So CONTRIBUTED = 297 posters, and all 32 invited/medal/plenary lectures are excluded. CHARACTER = HYBRID: a real open poster call bolted onto an invited lecture programme. ATTENDANCE: ~350 delegates is recorded WITH A WARNING — it comes from a uniindia report on the 33rd CRSI-NSC (Hyderabad) that I could NOT open (https://www.uniindia.com/33rd-crsi-national-symposium-in-chemistry-concludes-in-hyderabad/south/news/3237946.html now returns HTTP 404), so per rule 3 and 'never record a figure you only saw in a snippet' it has NO source_url and must not be treated as evidenced; it is noted only because it is consistent with the counted 297. VERDICT: OUT on positive evidence — 297 accepted contributed abstracts is ~3x below the ~900 floor, and that is a count off an accepted-abstract list, not an absence of evidence. Twice yearly (34th Feb 2025 IISER Bhopal, 35th July 2025 IIT Gandhinagar), so even both editions summed fall short.

conference: Reuniao Anual da Sociedade Brasileira de Quimica (RASBQ)
method: Rung 3, searched in PORTUGUESE ('numero de resumos / trabalhos / participantes'), which is what surfaced sbq.org.br rather than the English-language aggregator noise. The search only located the society; the number comes from counting. TRAIL: https://www.sbq.org.br/reunioes-anuais/ (curl, plain HTML) lists every edition's own site; https://www.sbq.org.br/48ra/ links '/48ra/anexos/ANAIS-48rasbq.pdf'. COUNTED: the complete Anais (proceedings/abstract book) of the 48a Reuniao Anual da SBQ, Campinas SP, 8-11 June 2025 — https://www.sbq.org.br/48ra/anexos/ANAIS-48rasbq.pdf, 277,828,476 bytes, 1,638 pages (pdfinfo). ID PATTERN: every abstract carries a right-aligned divisional marker 'Area:<CODE>' in its header. Count: re.findall(r'Área\s*:\s*([A-ZÇÃÉ]{2,6})') -> 1,368 markers, broken down MAT 220, ANA 163, ORG 158, INO 145, AMB 119, QPN 108, FIS 101, MED 94, EDU 76, ELE 73, CAT 59, BEA 23, FOT 22, which is 1,361 across the society's 13 scientific divisions, plus 7 stragglers on mistyped codes (ANAL 1, FQ 1, QMAT 1, QMT 1, PN 2, QNP 1) that are author typos of the same divisional codes and are legitimately included. 1,368 abstracts over 1,638 pages is ~1.2 pages each, consistent with a complete 1-2 page-abstract book and not with a truncated file. Cross-check per method rule: extracted twice, pdftotext -layout and -raw, and BOTH return exactly 1,368 with an IDENTICAL per-division breakdown, so extraction is not lossy. EXCLUSIONS: plenary and invited lectures do not go through the divisional abstract system and carry no 'Area:' marker, so they are structurally outside the 1,368; the count is contributed orals + posters only. DISAGREEMENT, RECORDED NOT RESOLVED (method rule: never average): SBQ's own Reunioes Anuais page states the meeting typically draws 'cerca de 2500 pesquisadores ... com apresentacoes de cerca de 2200 comunicacoes' — a round, un-editioned, typical-year claim that is ~60% above the counted 1,368. The COUNTED figure is the one recorded, per the rule that a count outranks a stated total; the 2,200 is logged here as the society's own higher claim and, if anything, means this row is conservative. ATTENDANCE: 2,500, basis UNSPECIFIED, rung A3 (society's own page, opened and read at https://www.sbq.org.br/reunioes-anuais/ — not a snippet), and it too is a typical-year figure rather than the 2025 actual. Implied ratio 1,368/2,500 = 55%, sitting between the chemistry anchors in the field notes (Mendeleev 45%, CCS National Congress 79%) and corroborating both figures. 1,368 is under the 1,500 VERIFIED bar and comfortably over the ~900 floor. NOTE for the field notes: SBQ's per-edition sites (sbq.org.br/<n>ra/) each carry an ANAIS PDF at /anexos/, so editions 38-48 are all countable this way at zero search cost — this is Brazil's national artefact and answers the 'Brazil is under-counted, its national index died' weakness recorded in the chemistry phase 1 notes.

conference: AIChE Spring Meeting & Global Congress on Process Safety
method: NO RUNG YIELDED A FIGURE — highest rung reached: 4 (artefact identified, fetch blocked). The countable artefact EXISTS and is named: AIChE deposits every paper of every meeting into proceedings.aiche.org, one record per presentation, browsable by conference and year, which is a clean rung-4 archive. It is behind Cloudflare. Tested 2026-09-12 with a spoofed desktop Chrome user-agent via curl on BOTH https://proceedings.aiche.org/conferences/aiche-spring-meeting-and-global-congress-on-process-safety/2025 and https://www.aiche.org/conferences/aiche-spring-meeting-and-global-congress-on-process-safety/2025/proceeding — both return HTTP 403 with the Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' interstitial (5,957 and 6,003 bytes), so the user-agent trick that beats spie.org does not beat this. Per the parallel-agent protocol, rung 5 is serial and reserved to the orchestrator, so this row returns NEEDS_RUNG_5 rather than UNKNOWN. This is the SAME wall that stopped queue row 19 (AIChE Annual Meeting) in pilot 2 — one browser session on proceedings.aiche.org settles both rows, and they are DIFFERENT meetings (Spring + GCPS vs Annual), not duplicates. EXACT NEXT ACTION: open https://proceedings.aiche.org/conferences/aiche-spring-meeting-and-global-congress-on-process-safety/2025 in Playwright or Chrome, read the result-count the listing states for the 2025 Spring Meeting, and exclude the plenary/award items. Character CONTRIBUTED is settled at zero cost by the existence of AIChE's open call for papers. Absence of a figure here is a tooling block, NOT evidence about the meeting's size — AIChE Spring is a multi-thousand-attendee meeting. Language: English (US society); no local-language pass applicable. Searches used: 0 — the block was found by fetching, not by searching.

conference: analytica Conference
method: Rung 2, searched in GERMAN ('analytica Conference München 2026 Anzahl Vorträge Programm Beiträge Teilnehmer'). Figures read off pages that were actually OPENED, not off snippets. TWO INDEPENDENT SOURCES AGREE: (1) the organiser's own page https://analytica.de/en/munich/analytica-conference/ states its programme in a key-figures block — '174 Lectures', '45 Sessions', '206 Presenters & Chairs', '2000 Participants'; (2) the trade-press announcement of the 2026 edition, https://www.chemie.de/news/1188034/analytica-conference-2026-von-der-blutkrebs-diagnostik-bis-zum-nachweis-von-opioiden.html, states 'Mit rund 190 Vorträgen in 45 Sessions, Preisverleihungen und einer Posterschau informiert die analytica conference', and elsewhere 'ungefähr 190 wissenschaftliche Vorträge und über 100 Postern'. FIGURE: ~174-190 lectures + >100 posters, recorded as 274 (the LOWER lecture figure, 174, plus 100 posters) so the number errs small rather than large; the two lecture counts differ only because one is the realised programme and the other the announcement. CHARACTER = CURATED, and this is the decisive point for the verdict rather than the arithmetic. The programme is built by three learned societies — GDCh, GBM and DGKL — as 45 society-organised sessions, and the organiser counts '206 Presenters & Chairs' as one category, i.e. speakers are session-programmed, not selected from an open call. Under the field-notes rule that trade fairs wear conference clothing (JASIS is the worked example: 312 'presentations' turned out to be 92 exhibitors' product talks), the contributed-science content here is essentially the poster show, ~100 items. EXCLUSIONS: the exhibition itself (1,100+ exhibitors across five halls at analytica 2026) is a trade fair and contributes zero abstracts; award ceremonies excluded. ATTENDANCE: 2,000, basis UNSPECIFIED, rung A1/A2 — this is the CONFERENCE attendance stated by the organiser, correctly NOT the analytica trade-fair gate figure, which is an order of magnitude larger and is made of exhibition visitors who cannot submit an abstract. VERDICT: OUT on positive evidence. Even counting every lecture as contributed, 274-290 is ~3x below the ~900 floor, and on the honest reading (posters only) it is ~100. Biennial. DISTINCT from queue row 294 'analytica China' — same brand, different meeting, in a different country, run by Messe Muenchen Shanghai; flagged so the two are not merged.

conference: NAM — North American Catalysis Society Meeting
method: Rung 3. The one search located nacatsoc.org; the artefact was then reached at ZERO further search cost via https://nacatsoc.org/resources/list-of-past-nam-programs/ (fetched with curl, plain HTML), which links the full programme books. COUNTED: NAM28 Program Book, https://nacatsoc.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/NAM28_Program-Book_2023-FINAL.pdf (11,151,305 bytes; NAM28, Providence RI, 18-23 June 2023) - NAM29 (2025) has no programme book posted on that page, so the most recent countable edition was used and the row is DATED by one edition. ID PATTERN: every presented item carries a slot ID of the form <Day>-<Room>-<HHMM> for orals (e.g. 'Mon-551AB-0930') and <Day>-P-<n> for posters (e.g. 'Mon-P-87'). Counts, on unique IDs: orals, re.findall(r'(?:Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri)-(?!P-)[A-Za-z0-9]+-\d{3,4}\b') -> 636; posters, re.findall(r'(?:Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri)-P-\d{1,4}\b') -> 320 (Mon 109 contiguous 1-109, Tue 109 contiguous 1-109, Wed 102 contiguous 1-102 - poster numbering restarts each day, which is why a day-blind P-\d regex collapses them to 109 and undercounts by 211; the day prefix is load-bearing). TOTAL 636 + 320 = 956. Cross-check per method rule: extracted twice, pdftotext -layout and -raw, and BOTH return exactly 636 orals and 320 posters, so extraction is not lossy. EXCLUSIONS: the 4 award lectures (Emmett, Boudart, Burwell, Houdry) are printed WITHOUT a slot ID - verified at the 2023 Paul H. Emmett Award Lecture, which shows '8:05 AM' and a title but no ID - so invited award talks are structurally outside the 956. The whole book contains ONE occurrence of 'Keynote' (inside a prose summary, not a programme label) and ZERO of 'Invited'. ATTENDANCE: 2,000, basis UNSPECIFIED, from the NACS NAM29 flyer (rung A3) which states the meeting 'promotes the exchange and cooperation between 2,000 academic and industrial professionals'; that is a round promotional figure, so it is recorded as context only. Ratio implied 956/2000 = 48%, consistent with the chemistry anchors in the field notes (Mendeleev 45%). Language: English (US/Canada/Mexico society). 956 clears the ~900 retention floor and is below the 1,500 VERIFIED bar; it is a genuinely near-floor row, so the count was re-derived twice as the method requires for decisive rows.

conference: Chemiedozententagung
method: Rung 3, searched in GERMAN ('GDCh Chemiedozententagung 2025 Teilnehmerzahl Vorträge Poster Beiträge'). The search returned no figure; the number comes from counting the programme. ROUTE, zero further searches: the GDCh event microsite (https://veranstaltungen.gdch.de/microsite/index.cfm?l=11723) is a JS-driven planner whose Programm/Poster tabs are not URLs and whose three download.cfm links all return ZERO bytes, so that road is a dead end — but the ADUC series page, https://www.gdch.de/netzwerk-strukturen/fachstrukturen/aduc/chemiedozententagung.html (curl, plain HTML), links the PROGRAMME PDF OF EVERY EDITION FROM 2001 TO 2025 on cdn.gdch.de. COUNTED: the 2025 programme, https://cdn.gdch.de/prod/2025_Programm_CDT_773c89da16.pdf, 957,261 bytes, 17 sheets (Chemiedozententagung 2025, TU Braunschweig, 17-19 March 2025). STRUCTURE: three parallel lecture tracks (Reihe A, B and C) over three days, in 20-minute slots, each printed as 'HH:MM <title> / <initial>. <Surname>, <City>/<Country>' — e.g. '14:20 Biomimetic Remote Functionalization of Aliphatic Alcohols, O. El-Sepelgy, Rostock/DE' — plus a 'Postdoc-Kurzvorträge' session, new in 2025. COUNT AND ITS UNCERTAINTY, declared rather than hidden: entries were counted as timed lines minus a non-scientific stop-list (Registrierung, Workshop, Eröffnung, Verleihung, Mittagspause, Kaffeepause, Festsitzung, Get-together, Mitgliederversammlung, Gründung, Impulsvortrag, Ars legendi, exkursion). pdftotext -layout gives 142 timed entries of which 90 are scientific; pdftotext -raw gives 207 of which 129. THE TWO EXTRACTIONS DISAGREE, and per the method that means extraction is lossy and the count is NOT exact: this PDF is typeset 2-up (two programme pages side by side per sheet), which interleaves the parallel-track columns differently under the two modes. I therefore record the LOWER figure, 90, as a FLOOR, with the true value inside a band of roughly 90-130 lectures. Only 3 occurrences of 'Poster' appear in the whole file, so there is little or no poster session to add. WHAT THE MEETING IS: GDCh's own description is 'ein Symposium, das den wissenschaftlichen Nachwuchs aus allen Bereichen der Chemie zusammenbringt', where 'Habilitandinnen und Juniorprofessoren' present their research — i.e. a junior-faculty showcase, with the ADUC-Nachwuchspreis and Carl-Duisberg-Gedächtnispreis ceremonies as its other spine. Character HYBRID. EXCLUSIONS: award lectures, the GDCh-Festsitzung, workshops and the Impulsvortrag are all in the stop-list and outside the 90. VERDICT: OUT on positive evidence. Even at the TOP of the extraction band (129) the meeting is ~7x below the ~900 floor, so the extraction disagreement cannot change the verdict — which is why it was acceptable to stop here rather than resolve it. ATTENDANCE: not stated in the programme and not on any page that loaded (the ChemistryViews report on CDT 2025 at https://www.chemistryviews.org/scientific-exchange-highlights-from-chemiedozententagung-2025/ is behind Cloudflare, HTTP 403 to both WebFetch and a spoofed-UA curl); left null per rule 3. Annual, every edition's programme PDF openly archived back to 2001 if a better year is ever wanted.

conference: SCI Congresso Nazionale (Societa Chimica Italiana) — RENAME: SCI has no society-wide national congress; its congresses are DIVISIONAL. Largest counted here: XXI Congresso Nazionale della Divisione di Chimica dell'Ambiente e dei Beni Culturali (SCI-ABC 2025, Cremona)
method: Rung 3, searched in ITALIAN ('Congresso Nazionale Società Chimica Italiana 2025 numero contributi comunicazioni poster partecipanti' and a second for the society-wide congress). STRUCTURAL FINDING FIRST, because it decides the row: THE QUEUED MEETING DOES NOT EXIST AS A SINGLE EVENT. SCI's own congress listing, https://www.oldsoc.chim.it/it/congressi (fetched with curl; note the main hosts soc.chim.it, chim.it and societachimica.it/it/congressi all fail on a cert-altname mismatch or 404 — oldsoc.chim.it is the one that serves), is tabbed 'Congressi SCI / Congressi Divisioni / Congressi Sezioni / Congressi Gruppi' and its entire 2025 list is DIVISIONAL: XLII Convegno Nazionale della Divisione di Chimica Organica (CDCO 2025), XXI Congresso Nazionale della Divisione di Chimica dell'Ambiente e dei Beni Culturali, III Convegno Nazionale di Chimica per le Tecnologie, XIV Congresso Nazionale di Chimica degli Alimenti (CHIMALI 2025), the Joint 50th Congress of the Physical Chemistry Division with the 5th European Conference on Physical Chemistry, ISA 2025, and the Congresso Nazionale della Divisione di Chimica dei Sistemi Biologici. There is NO society-wide 'Congresso Nazionale SCI' on it. SCI is structured as 17 Divisioni plus ~25 Gruppi Tematici plus regional Sezioni, each running its own congress — the same index-page-society shape the field notes record for RSEQ. Per the RSEQ precedent the row is RENAMED rather than silently deleted, so a later session can find the real meetings. SIZE, COUNTED on a real artefact: the complete book of abstracts of SCI-ABC 2025 (Cremona, 10-13 Sept 2025), https://www.congressodabc.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/SCI_ABC_2025_CREMONA_BOOK_OF_ABSTRACT.pdf, 4,029,523 bytes, 209 pages. Every abstract is headed with its own type label, so the invited split is exact: case-sensitive tally of the type words gives ORAL 118, POSTER 59, INVITED 11. CONTRIBUTED = 118 + 59 = 177; the 11 INVITED are EXCLUDED. Cross-check per method rule: extracted twice, pdftotext -layout and -raw, both yielding the same document and tally. INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION: a third-party announcement of the same congress reports '129 oral contributions and 57 posters' — 129 = 118 contributed orals + 11 invited, and 57 vs 59 posters, i.e. both sources agree to within two items and differ only in whether invited talks are folded into the oral count. That agreement is what makes 177 trustworthy. SCOPE CAVEAT, stated rather than hidden: SCI-ABC is one division of seventeen and is NOT necessarily the largest — the Organic Chemistry division's CDCO is probably bigger — so 177 sizes a REPRESENTATIVE divisional congress, not the biggest one. It is still the right shape of number: Italian divisional congresses run in the low hundreds, and the field notes already record the same pattern for Spain's RSEQ groups at 50-200. VERDICT: OUT — not because nothing was found, but on positive evidence of BOTH kinds: the society publishes no society-wide congress, and the divisional congress that was counted comes to 177, roughly 5x below the ~900 floor. ATTENDANCE: not published on any page that loaded; left null per rule 3. NOTE for a later session: indico.chem.polimi.it hosts at least one SCI divisional congress (event 60, the DCT/AICIng joint congress), and per the method an Indico host returns an exact contribution count from /export/event/<id>.json?detail=contributions — that endpoint was unreachable from here (curl exit 60, TLS) but is the cheapest route to size the remaining divisions.

conference: Mendeleev Congress on General and Applied Chemistry

Each abstract occupies one page and carries one running-header label, which is confirmed structurally: labels per volume come to 610/499/339/302/332 against page counts of 632/523/361/324/371, i.e. labels = pages less ~22-39 pages of front matter in every volume. CONTRIBUTED = 539 oral + 1,259 poster = 1,798. EXCLUDED: 284 invited items (8 plenary + 52 keynote + 224 invited) and 606 ЗАОЧНЫЙ in-absentia items (Tom_6 347 + Tom_7 259) — counting the whole collection would have given 2,688 and overstated this row by 49%. ATTENDANCE: 4,000, basis UNSPECIFIED, rung A3, read off the congress's OWN news page https://mendeleevcongress.ru/novosti/ (opened, not a snippet): 'Четыре тысячи участников, в том числе более 200 международных участников из 38 стран мира'. Implied ratio 1,798/4,000 = 45%, below the CCS National Congress anchor and consistent with a congress whose programme carries 284 invited lectures. DUPLICATE WARNING RETAINED: a Mendeleev Congress row may already exist elsewhere in the chemistry census under its Russian name (Менделеевский съезд по общей и прикладной химии). conference: KCS General Meeting and Academic Presentation Conference (대한화학회 학술발표회)
method: Rung 4, searched in KOREAN ('대한화학회 학술발표회 초록 발표 논문 수 참가자'), which is what surfaced kchem.org; an English query returns nothing usable. The search located the society only — the number is READ OFF THE SOCIETY'S OWN ABSTRACT-STATISTICS TABLE, which is a purpose-built count, not a snippet. ARTEFACT: KCS publishes a '초록 통계' (Abstract Statistic) page per meeting at https://kchem.org/society/kcs/conf/<kcsNNN>/abs/stat — plain HTML, no JS, no login, reachable with curl. It is a per-track table whose columns are exactly the invited/contributed split this census needs: 기조강연 (plenary), 기념강연 (award/memorial lecture), 분과기조 (division keynote), 분과기념 (division award), 심포지엄 (symposium/invited), 구두발표 (CONTRIBUTED ORAL), 포스터 (POSTER), 합계 (total). METHOD OF COUNT: fetched with urllib (UA Mozilla/5.0), took the one <table> containing '구두발표', parsed <tr>/<td> to cells, keyed the columns BY HEADER NAME rather than by position (necessary — kcs134 serves the same columns in a DIFFERENT order, so a positional parse silently mixes orals with award lectures), and summed each column over the 62 track rows. RESULT for kcs137: 구두발표 232 + 포스터 2,688 = 2,920 CONTRIBUTED; invited (the other five columns) = 359; 2,920 + 359 = 3,279, which EXACTLY reproduces the page's own stated 합계 of 3,279. That independent reconciliation is what makes the number trustworthy (method rule 7, sanity-check against the artefact's own stated total). SERIES, all four editions parsed and all four reconciling exactly to their own stated totals: kcs135 212 oral + 1,820 poster = 2,032 contributed (invited 350, total 2,382); kcs136 212 + 1,728 = 1,940 (invited 354, total 2,294); kcs137 232 + 2,688 = 2,920 (invited 359, total 3,279); kcs138 204 + 1,552 = 1,756 (invited 420, total 2,176). kcs138 is the UPCOMING autumn 2026 meeting (its welcome message reads 'To be announced'), so its figure is still accumulating and is NOT the one recorded; kcs137 is the most recent completed edition (its award lectures are dated 2026). EXCLUSIONS: the 359 invited items — plenaries, award lectures, division keynotes and symposium speakers — are excluded by construction, since only the 구두발표 and 포스터 columns are summed. TWICE-YEARLY meeting (spring + autumn), so events/yr = 2, and EVERY edition parsed clears the 1,500 bar on contributed alone. ATTENDANCE: not published on this page and not otherwise found on a page that loaded, so left null per rule 3 rather than guessed. NOTE for the chemistry field notes: this stat page is Korea's national artefact and the direct analogue of the CCS paper-retrieval index — it settles any KCS meeting at ZERO search cost, and the column order varies by edition so it must be parsed by header.

conference: Indian Chemical Society Annual Convention / National Convention of Chemists (ACC)
method: Rung 3, English (Indian societies publish in English, so no local-language pass applies). The search located the society; the number comes from counting its abstract book. FETCH TRAP WORTH RECORDING: indianchemicalsociety.com serves every /uploaded_files/*.pdf link as a ~3.9KB HTML 'File Preview' wrapper, NOT the PDF — a naive curl saves the wrapper and the row looks unresolvable. The real file is in the wrapper's iframe src, a time-limited Azure blob SAS URL on mswebdocstorage.blob.core.windows.net; fetching the wrapper and following that src retrieves the actual PDF (19,995,357 bytes). COUNTED: 'Proceedings of the 58th Annual Convention of Chemists (ACC-2021) & International Conference on Recent Trends in Chemical Sciences (RTCS-2021), December 21-24 2021 — ABSTRACTS', Indian Chemical Society, Kolkata; 628 pages. THE BOOK STATES ITS OWN COUNTS, which is the best kind of artefact: it is divided into six subject sections (Inorganic, Organic, Physical etc.), and each section opens with a header block declaring its ID ranges, e.g. 'Inorganic Chemistry / Young Scientist Award Papers / Oral Presentation (AO): 01-12 / Poster Presentation (AP): 01-04 / General Papers / Oral Presentation (OP): 01-16 / Poster Presentation (PP): 01-05'. Count: re.findall(r'(Oral|Poster)\s+Presentation\s*\(([A-Z]{2})\)\s*:?\s*(\d{1,3})\s*[–-]\s*(\d{1,3})') finds 24 declared range blocks (6 sections x 4 categories) and summing (end - start + 1) gives AO 89 + AP 12 + OP 87 + PP 34 = 222. THE ID PREFIX RESTARTS PER SECTION, so a book-wide unique-ID count would collapse them and undercount badly — summing the declared ranges is the correct method here. Cross-check per method rule: extracted twice, pdftotext -layout and -raw, and BOTH return 24 blocks and the identical per-code totals; independently, raw occurrence counts of each prefix across the book (AO 89, OP 87, PP 35/34, AP 14/12) reproduce the same figures. EXCLUSIONS: all 222 are CONTRIBUTED — 'Young Scientist Award Papers' are competitively submitted and 'General Papers' are the open call; plenary and invited lectures sit outside these numbered ranges and are not counted. CHARACTER HYBRID (a genuine open call plus an invited/award lecture spine). CORROBORATION for the current edition: the 62nd ACC's own final schedule (https://indianchemicalsociety.com/uploaded_files/62ACC-Final-Schedule.pdf, same wrapper route) is SIX PAGES long, consistent with a meeting of the same order and not with one that has grown tenfold. DATED to 2021 — that edition was partly COVID-affected, so 222 should be read as a floor; even at 4x it does not approach the bar. VERDICT: OUT on positive evidence — 222 counted contributed abstracts is ~4x below the ~900 floor. ATTENDANCE: not stated in the volume; left null per rule 3. DUPLICATE/CONFLATION FLAG: queue row 14 is titled 'CSI — Chemical Research Society of India / ICS Annual Convention' and so bundles THIS meeting into a row I resolved as CRSI's National Symposium. CRSI and the Indian Chemical Society are DIFFERENT societies with different meetings; rows 14 and 162 are therefore NOT duplicates of each other, but row 14's title wrongly names this meeting and should be corrected to CRSI-only so the two are not double-counted or merged.

method: Rung 3, searched in JAPANESE ('高分子学会年次大会 2025 発表件数 参加者数' and '"高分子学会年次大会" 講演数 発表件数 約 件 予稿集'). ID form is <day><room><slot><suffix>, and THE SUFFIX IS THE INVITED FLAG: re.findall(r'\b(\d[A-Z]\d{2}[A-Z]{0,3})\b') over unique IDs gives 526 with NO suffix (contributed), 43 'IL' (Invited Lecture), 14 'AL' (Award Lecture, e.g. 1A18AL 国際賞受賞講演 / 3A06AL 学会賞受賞講演) and 15 'ILI'/'ILY' which are 'IL' ids with a stray adjacent character. ID form <day>P<track><nnn>, e.g. 1Pa005: re.findall(r'\b(\d)P([a-z])(\d{3})\b') gives 744 unique IDs across 16 day-track blocks (1Pa 49, 1Pb 48, 1Pc 45, 1Pd 48, 1Pe 43, 1Pf 42, 2Pa 49, 2Pb 45, 2Pc 49, 2Pd 47, 2Pe 47, 2Pf 49, 3Pa 48, 3Pb 46, 3Pc 44, 3Pd 45). ATTENDANCE: not published on any page that loaded; left null per rule 3 rather than guessed. DATED by two editions (73rd/2024 is the most recent with an open programme; the 74th and 75th are member-walled), and SPSJ is a ~12,000-member society whose meeting is growing, so 1,270 is a FLOOR for the current edition. 1,270 clears the ~900 retention floor and is under the 1,500 VERIFIED bar. DISTINCT MEETING from queue row 250, SPSJ 高分子討論会 (the autumn Symposium on Macromolecules) — not a duplicate; and NOTE for whoever reworks row 250, which pilot 2 left UNRESOLVED: the same open-PDF route almost certainly settles it, since main.spsj.or.jp hosts the 討論会 sites in the same pattern.

conference: Catalysis Society of Japan Annual Meeting (触媒討論会)
method: Rung 3, searched in JAPANESE ('触媒討論会 討論会A講演 発表件数 参加者 触媒学会'). CURRENT EDITIONS ARE CONFIT-WALLED, confirmed by test rather than assumed: https://confit.atlas.jp/guide/event/catsj137/top, /catsj137/subject/list and /catsj136/top all return HTTP 202 with a ZERO-BYTE body to curl with a desktop Chrome UA — exactly the Confit behaviour the chemistry field notes record, i.e. a rung-5 job. BUT an older STATIC programme survives on the legacy site and was counted: https://www.shokubai.org/meeting/program.html links two open PDFs for the 125th 触媒討論会 (Kogakuin Univ. Shinjuku, 26-27 March 2020) — 125_oral.pdf (511,910 bytes) and 125_poster.pdf (763,067 bytes). COUNT: IDs are <day><room><nn>, e.g. 1Ａ01(B1) for orals and 1P01 for posters, written with FULL-WIDTH room letters in the oral file and half-width in the poster file. Normalised full-width A-Z to half-width, stripped spaces and ideographic spaces, then re.findall(r'(?<![0-9A-Z])(\d[A-EP]\d{2})(?![0-9])') -> ORALS 32 (1A 9, 1B 9, 2A 7, 2B 7) and POSTERS 175 (1P 89, 2P 86). That disagreement was real and was a BUG, not lossy extraction — Python treats kanji as word characters, so \b never matches between '01' and the immediately following Japanese title text, and stripping spaces in a two-column layout then fused IDs. With the lookaround pattern above, pdftotext -layout and -raw agree EXACTLY on both files (32 and 175), which is the cross-check the method requires. EXCLUSIONS: the file contains 2 招待講演/特別講演 (invited/special lectures) and 1 講演中止 (withdrawn); the 207 is contributed orals + posters. VERDICT: 207 per edition, ~400/yr across both meetings, is POSITIVE evidence of a meeting roughly 4x below the ~900 floor — not an absence-of-evidence UNKNOWN — so OUT. EVIDENCE: the organiser's Chinese site (https://www.analyticachina.com.cn/cn/Discover-analytica-China/Press-Release/Exhibition-News/detail/China%201, fetched with curl, 85,962 bytes) enumerates the whole 同期活动 (concurrent programme) of analytica China 2026 (Shanghai New International Expo Centre, 16-18 Nov 2026). The site's own navigation is organised around 展区 (exhibition zones), 展商中心 (exhibitor centre), 观众预登记 (visitor pre-registration) and 展台搭建 (stand construction). There is NO 摘要 (abstract) call, NO 征稿 (call for papers) and NO 论文集 (proceedings) anywhere in the programme. CONTRIBUTED ABSTRACTS = 0. This is precisely the shape the chemistry field notes record for JASIS (312 'presentations' that turned out to be 92 exhibitors' product talks, contributed abstracts 0) and ARABLAB (350 'expert speakers', no abstract call) — a trade fair wearing conference clothing. CORROBORATION from the same brand: its far larger parent, the analytica Conference in Munich (queue row 26), musters only ~174-190 society-programmed lectures plus ~100 posters, so the Shanghai sibling's forum programme cannot plausibly be an order of magnitude bigger. ATTENDANCE: not recorded — the only headcounts this fair publishes are 观众 (exhibition visitors), who are trade-show attendees and cannot submit an abstract, so per the basis-tag rule they would be the wrong number to carry and are deliberately left null rather than written down misleadingly. VERDICT: OUT on POSITIVE evidence — a documented absence of any contributed-abstract programme, not an absence of evidence about size. Biennial. DISTINCT from queue row 26 'analytica Conference' (Munich, Messe München) — same brand, different meeting and country; flagged so the two rows are not merged.

conference: 全国固态化学与无机合成学术会议 (CCS Solid State Chemistry and Inorganic Synthesis Conference)
method: RE-DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY FROM THE PRIMARY SOURCE on 2026-09-12 after a blind-run constraint was imposed; an earlier version of this row was built from a pre-existing local crawl file and has been discarded. Rung 4, zero searches, searched in CHINESE (固态 / 无机合成) against the society's own index. LIVE METHOD, reproducible from this text alone: the CCS paper-retrieval system at https://www.chemsoc.org.cn/library/papers/ needs a SESSION COOKIE plus a Referer of the index page or it 302s to index.php and returns nothing; with urllib + http.cookiejar.CookieJar, a UA of Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/126 and Referer https://www.chemsoc.org.cn/library/papers/, fetch the index once to seed the session, then walk ?page=1..21 (the index states '共找到210个会议 10个/页 第1/21页'). Pair each meeting's id to its name WITHIN THE SAME <tr> — a naive zip of the id list against a separately-scraped name list silently misaligns them and I hit that error before fixing it. 210 meetings paired; filtering names on 固态化学与无机合成 returns EXACTLY FOUR editions, and no others exist in the index: id=219 (12th, 2012, Qingdao), id=231 (13th, 2014, Changchun), id=23 (14th, 2016, Tianjin), id=281 (16th, 2021, Beijing National Convention Center). Each meeting.php page carries a 论文集 table of 摘要集 volumes, each stating its own 论文数; parsed the <tr>/<td> cells and summed: 12th = 272 (1 volume), 13th = 354 (1 volume), 14th = 197 (1 volume), 16th = 52 (12 per-division volumes: MOFs与无机多孔材料 17, 固态化学及材料的光电磁功能 11, 能源环境与催化化学 8, 中空无机固体的合成化学 4, 生物无机与仿生材料 1, 青年论坛 2, 原子催化 2, 纳米与低维材料 2, 稀土固态化学 1, and three journal-linked volumes 2+1+1). EXCLUSIONS: no edition carries a 大会特邀报告 (plenary-invited) volume, so contributed = total for all four and no invited subtraction was needed. FIGURE: the LARGEST indexed edition, 354 (2014), recorded as a floor for the series. The 16th's 52 is treated as PATCHY INDEXING, not as shrinkage — 12 divisional volumes averaging four abstracts each is not a real divisional congress, and the field notes already record that this index is patchy and skews old. DATED: the queue's current edition is the 18th, which is not in the index at all. VERDICT: OUT — even at 2.5x the best indexed edition the series does not reach the ~900 floor, so this is positive evidence of a sub-floor meeting rather than absence of evidence. NOT the same series as 全国第十一届有机固体电子过程 (749), despite the shared 固 character.

conference: Кузнецовские чтения (Kuznetsov Readings, Novosibirsk)
method: Rung 3, searched in RUSSIAN ('Кузнецовские чтения Новосибирск конференция тезисы докладов участников') using the local term тезисы, per the mandatory local-language rule.
